strings.graph_failed_notice: The graph could not be opened; tap Graph to try again.
strings.graph_nodes_text: Each box is one of the main results the repository names in its last step.
strings.key_kinds_note: Parts and groups follow the repository's own contents list (CONTENTS.md).
strings.key_lines_text: A line joins two files of the same group: the upper file uses definitions or results from the lower one. Where a path of lines already connects two files, no direct line is drawn between them. Uses across groups are not drawn. Lean also uses results it fills in on its own without naming them; those uses are not counted.
strings.key_scope_text: The map holds the 306 Lean files of the proof's own argument (the folder New). Two short files at the top of the repository are not on it. In the repository's words (grh/README.md): "`src/Statements.lean` states the theorems in Mathlib's terms. `src/Main.lean` proves five theorems", the Riemann Hypothesis among them, each in a line or two from results on this map or from one another. (The map's file named Main is New/Main.lean, a different file.) The map also leaves out the repository's own 495 library files (the folder Lib) and Mathlib. A file's uses of those are not drawn.
strings.link_refused: That address does not name a step on this map.
strings.parts_failed_notice: The parts of this step could not be opened; tap it to try again.
strings.spine_lines_text: A line means the upper result rests on the lower one. Made-up words of the fixture.
